phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, own posture unknown or ground-oriented, opponent ground posture with light tech, both heavy economy.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when more enemy units are scouted or when transitioning to mid-game.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize ground strength and tech, expand cautiously, keep defense up.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground forces, increase economy and technology, maintain defense and expansions.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Tech Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to tech or economy at the expense of scouting and defensive readiness; avoid neglecting ground defense while expanding.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-mid game, own ground posture with Zealots and Stalkers, opponent ground with Zerglings and Queens, both heavy economy.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Consolidate ground army, grow economy and production, keep tech steady.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground forces, increase economy and production, maintain tech development.
phase_policies.title: Early-Mid Ground Consolidation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend production or economy without ensuring scouting and defense; avoid neglecting anti-air capability.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, own ground posture with Zealots, Stalkers, Observers, Immortals, opponent ground with Zerglings, Queens, Overseers, both heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground strength, keep economy and tech, upgrade as needed.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground forces, maintain economy and tech, consider upgrades.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air or overcommit to ground without scouting for air transitions; avoid ignoring defensive upgrades.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-mid game, own ground posture with Zealots and Stalkers, opponent ground with Zerglings, Roaches, Queens, both heavy tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Stabilize ground army, sustain economy and tech, upgrade defenses.
phase_policies.target: Maintain ground strength, continue economy and tech, consider defensive upgrades.
phase_policies.title: Late-Mid Ground Stability
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to economy or tech while neglecting army production and scouting; avoid ignoring defensive upgrades.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
